_comment: Debug-module data0/data1 addresses read from the RISC-V DM hartinfo.dataaddr register over WCH-LinkE, reported by the ArduinoCore-CH32 consumer (worklist R-27). Hand-recorded measurements; tools/build_debug_data.py folds them into evidence/debug_data.csv as the basis `hartinfo:wch-linke`.
method: hartinfo.dataaddr read through WCH-LinkE while implementing SDI print (DMDATA0/1 mailbox printf) in ArduinoCore-CH32
